'''Ynysdail Cavern''' is a dungeon beneath [[Ynysdail]]. 

The dungeon contains several mining spots containing a total of seven [[mithril rocks|mithril]], eight [[Adamantite rocks|adamantite]] and two [[runite rocks]]. 

It also contains a small assortment of Slayer monsters; [[rockslug]]s, [[jelly|jellies]] and is the only location to house [[aquanite]]s. The entire dungeon is a single-combat zone and [[Dwarf multicannon]]s cannot be set in the dungeon; attempting to do so will result in the message "The ground is too damp to set up a cannon here."
